拡張機能自体の機能は性能の悪いページ画像キャプチャ。ウィンドウモードで表を選択したらスクロールバーまでキャプチャされた。そうしてコピーした表画像を自社の画像解析サイトにアップロードしてcsv等に変換する仕組み。
通常のHTML上の表を取り込みたいだけなら似て非なる「Table Capture」を使った方がいいだろう。あちらは一瞬で正確なものを取り込んでくれる。

reviews.author: Shaun P
reviews.text: Unless the tables were pretty simple, it's unclear why this extension is rated so highly. 1) it's basically a web image capture and extraction program, not an HTML table capture program, 2) because the content needs to fit on the screen, for large tables, you will need to zoom out, which limits the size of table you can capture, 3) the captured image is sent to an online extraction app, which gives you one free extraction (i.e. it's not free after the first), and 4) the online extraction app ... 더보기

Если таблица требует пролистывания, то данное приложение этого не умеет, т.е. придётся распознавать её по частям.

reviews.author: Asifur Rahman
reviews.text: uploading sensitive internal reports or client spreadsheets to online table converters feels super unsafe.this tool handles all table detection,editing,and file generation locally inside chrome without asking for accounts or paywalls.it never touches external networks unless you deliberately load a remote pdf link.a clean,trustworthy utility for everyday browser exports.
